decision_log.jinfiniti_added: Added to panel-package section — was missing from every vendor list in the original 8-phase spec despite being a full INCLUDE-NICHE vendor with completed research (including the 25-marker and 18-marker audit passes). Section = panel-package because its Essential/Advanced/Ultimate/Menopause tiers are one-time purchases, same model as Marek and Vitals Vault.
decision_log.just_labs_excluded: Reverted to EXCLUDE, consistent with the original vendor eligibility audit (dead justlabs.com domain, live justlabs.health entity lacks distinguishing longevity-platform features). The original 8-phase spec resurrected it as the sole Build-Your-Own vendor with no stated rationale — treated as a spec error, not a deliberate reversal.
decision_log.goodlabs_moved: Moved from panel-package to build-your-own. Goodlabs' research-confirmed identity is fundamentally a la carte (individual $3-134 Quest-priced tests across 200+ SKUs), which fits the 'order exactly the tests you need' Build-Your-Own section description better than Panel Packages. This also resolves the schema conflict where the original spec tried to cross-list Goodlabs into two sections simultaneously — the section column can only hold one value per vendor.
decision_log.vendor_name_corrections: Original spec used bare 'SiPhox' and 'Rythm' — corrected to the exact vendor_name strings from lab_vendor_audit.json: 'SiPhox Health' and 'Rythm Health'.
